ody.text: Emperor Aboshan became suspicious of Llawan and exiled her to the southern court, while Laquatus made himself central to Aboshan's court and stoked his fears.
Aboshan found the Mirari in his treasury, declared that all life would return to the sea, and prepared to flood Otaria.
He poured mana into the Mirari, flooding the northern third of Otaria, but the spell destroyed his capital and killed him.
